_source: https://github.com/DitriXNew/EDT-MCP/issues/363#issuecomment-5241732183 (VVi3ard). Tools absent from that table are marked _authored: written in the same style for this benchmark.
adopt_metadata_object: Add a base-configuration object or member to an extension for customization.
apply_quick_fix: Apply an EDT quick fix to a validation problem.
build_external_objects: Compile external 1C data processors and reports into deployable files.
cancel_job: Cancel a background job by its jobId.
clean_project: Reload metadata changed outside EDT and refresh the in-memory project state.
create_git_branch: Start isolated work on a new Git branch for an EDT project.
create_infobase: Prepare an infobase for an EDT project by creating a database or registering an existing one.
create_launch_config: Configure an EDT runtime client for launching a 1C application.
create_metadata: Add a new metadata object or member to a configuration.
create_project: Start a new EDT configuration, extension, or external-objects project.
debug_launch: Run a 1C application under EDT debugging.
debug_status: Check which EDT debug sessions are running or paused.
debug_yaxunit_tests: Run YAXUnit tests under the debugger.
delete_infobase: Remove a project's infobase or standalone-server association.
delete_launch_config: Remove an unused EDT runtime or attach launch configuration.
delete_metadata: Delete a metadata object or member.
delete_project: Remove an EDT project from the workspace.
enable_toolset: Make additional MCP tool groups visible or hide them.
evaluate_expression: Inspect runtime values by evaluating a BSL expression in a paused debug frame.
export_common_picture: Inspect or extract the image data of a 1C common picture.
export_configuration_to_xml: Export an EDT configuration into 1C XML files.
find_references: Discover where a metadata object is used throughout the configuration and BSL code.
generate_translation_strings: Collect translatable strings of a configuration for a translation provider.
get_applications: Discover infobases connected to an EDT project.
get_check_description: Understand an EDT validation rule and how to fix its diagnostic.
get_configuration_properties: Inspect the identity and compatibility settings of a 1C configuration.
get_content_assist: Find valid BSL completion suggestions at a source-code position.
get_event_log: Investigate infobase activity and errors through its event log.
get_form_layout_snapshot: Inspect the calculated visual layout of an EDT form.
get_form_screenshot: Visually inspect an EDT form as rendered by the designer.
get_job_status: Poll a background job by its jobId.
get_markers: Find bookmarks and TODO-style task markers in the workspace.
get_mcp_history: Diagnose MCP tool calls by reviewing recent requests, failures, timings, and context usage.
get_metadata_details: Inspect the properties and structure of a metadata object or member.
get_metadata_objects: Discover metadata objects available in a 1C configuration.
get_method_call_hierarchy: Trace which BSL methods call a method or are called by it.
get_module_structure: Discover procedures, functions, regions, and execution contexts in a BSL module.
get_objects_by_tags: Find metadata objects organized under selected tags.
get_outgoing_structures: Discover the fields passed to outgoing or qualified BSL method calls.
get_platform_documentation: Find the exact API of a built-in 1C type or global function.
get_problem_summary: See validation problem counts grouped by project and severity.
get_profiling_results: Identify performance hotspots in executed BSL code.
get_project_errors: Find detailed validation errors and warnings in an EDT project.
get_server_status: Diagnose the EDT MCP server and its feature configuration.
get_subsystem_content: Inspect which metadata objects and child subsystems belong to a 1C subsystem.
get_symbol_info: Inspect the type and documentation of a BSL symbol at its source location.
get_tags: Discover user-defined tags used to organize project metadata.
get_template_screenshot: Visually inspect how a spreadsheet print template renders.
get_tool_guide: Retrieve detailed instructions for an MCP tool.
get_translation_project_info: Inspect the translation setup of an EDT project.
get_variables: Inspect runtime variables in a paused debug frame.
go_to_definition: Locate the source definition of a BSL symbol or metadata object.
import_configuration_from_xml: Create an EDT project from exported 1C configuration XML files.
list_breakpoints: Review breakpoints currently set in BSL source code.
list_common_pictures: Inventory common pictures available in a 1C configuration.
list_configurations: Discover EDT runtime and server-side launch configurations.
list_git_branches: Inspect available Git branches and their EDT infobase bindings.
list_modules: Discover BSL modules available in an EDT project.
list_projects: Discover projects available in the EDT workspace.
list_subsystems: Discover the subsystem hierarchy of a 1C configuration.
list_toolsets: Discover available groups of MCP tools and their visibility.
modify_metadata: Set properties of any metadata node (object or member, including form items, attributes, commands, and handlers).
read_method_source: Inspect the source of one BSL procedure or function.
read_module_source: Inspect the source of a complete BSL module.
remove_breakpoint: Stop pausing execution at a BSL source breakpoint.
rename_metadata_object: Rename a metadata object or member throughout its configuration references.
resync_to_disk: Recover missing metadata files or dangling configuration references before an EDT update or XML export.
revalidate_objects: Refresh validation after metadata files or selected objects change outside EDT.
run_yaxunit_tests: Run YAXUnit tests for a 1C configuration.
search_in_code: Find literal text or patterns across BSL source code.
set_branch_infobase: Associate an existing infobase with a Git branch of an EDT project.
set_breakpoint: Pause BSL execution at a selected source line during debugging.
set_infobase_credentials: Enable EDT to connect to a protected infobase for updates or debugging.
set_variable: Change a variable while execution is paused in the debugger.
start_profiling: Measure execution time and coverage of BSL code in a debug session.
step: Advance paused debug execution one step.
stop_profiling: Finish measuring BSL performance in a debug session.
switch_git_branch: Change the active version of an EDT project through Git branch checkout.
terminate_launch: Stop a 1C session started by EDT.
translate_configuration: Translate a 1C configuration into target languages.
update_database: Apply the current EDT configuration to an infobase.
validate_query: Check a 1C query for syntax and metadata-reference errors.
validate_xdto_package: Check an XDTO package for configuration validation problems.
wait_for_break: Wait until a running 1C debug session reaches a breakpoint or other suspend event.
write_module_source: Create or edit BSL source in a metadata module.
